meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: Claude 会把代码评审意见压成一行一条:位置、问题、修复,并可按需加严重度前缀(🔴 bug、🟡 risk、🔵 nit、❓ q)。它只输出可直接粘进 PR 的评论,不改代码、不做批准或驳回、不跑 linter。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-review,或说“review this PR”“review the diff”时触发。

say.note: 按一行一条输出评审意见

say.text: 用 caveman-review 审这个 PR
say.note: 发现的问题带位置、问题、修复

howto.what_en: Claude writes compressed code review comments: one line per finding with location, problem and fix, plus optional severity prefixes (🔴 bug, 🟡 risk, 🔵 nit, ❓ q). It outputs comments ready to paste into the PR; it does not write the fix, approve or request changes, or run linters.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman-review, or when you say "review this PR" or "review the diff".

say_en.note: Findings come with location, problem, fix
